implemented_requirements.requirement: Define difficulty levels and maximum mistakes
Store puzzle data with categories, difficulty, and words
implemented_requirements.evidence: this.categories = puzzle.categories.map(c => ({ name: c.name, difficulty: c.difficulty, words: [...c.words] }));

implemented_requirements.requirement: Map each word to its category
implemented_requirements.evidence: this.wordToCategory = new Map(); this.categories.forEach(cat => cat.words.forEach(w => this.wordToCategory.set(w, cat)));

implemented_requirements.requirement: Initialize game state (word list, shuffle order, selection, mistakes)
implemented_requirements.evidence: initState() { this.allWords = this.categories.flatMap(c => c.words); this.displayOrder = this.shuffleArray([...this.allWords]); this.selected = []; this.solved = []; this.mistakesRemaining = MAX_MISTAKES; this.gameOver = false; }

shuffle() { const solvedWords = new Set(this.solvedCategoryWords()); const remaining = this.displayOrder.filter(w => !solvedWords.has(w)); this.displayOrder = [...this.solvedCategoryWords(), ...this.shuffleArray(remaining)]; }

implemented_requirements.requirement: Generate a daily puzzle based on date
Validate a group of four words against a category and provide feedback
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code present that checks a four‑word selection, marks it correct/incorrect, updates mistakesRemaining, or reveals the category/difficulty.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display words in a 4x4 grid with color‑coded difficulty for solved groups
implemented_requirements.evidence: No UI/DOM manipulation code; only data structures are defined.
No logic to ensure uniqueness of the solution.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Limit mistakes to four and end the game on exceeding
implemented_requirements.evidence: mistakesRemaining is defined but never decremented or checked.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide immediate feedback after each guess

critical_issues: shuffleArray method is a placeholder ('Fisher-Yates') and not implemented, breaking any shuffle functionality.
No code to generate or load a daily puzzle; puzzles.js only contains a date helper.
Missing logic to evaluate a selected group of four words, determine correctness, update solved state, and display category with difficulty color.
Mistake handling is incomplete: mistakesRemaining is never updated and game over conditions are not enforced.
No user interface (HTML/CSS/DOM) to present the 4x4 grid, handle clicks, show feedback, or indicate colors.
No mechanism to ensure only one correct solution exists.
Overall code is incomplete and cannot be executed as a functional game.
judge.summary: The submitted code contains only skeletal data structures and very limited game‑state management. Core gameplay mechanics—daily puzzle generation, word grouping validation, mistake tracking, UI rendering, shuffle implementation, and feedback—are missing or stubbed. Consequently, the project does not meet the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to run as a functional puzzle game.
